accepted.evidence: Turner2817 gives Kumaoni kākṛo, Nepali kā̃kro and Bihari kakri cucumber via Prakrit kakkaḍa. Darai kakra belongs to this contracted regional cucumber family. Source p59 explicitly prints /kak.ra/ cucumber; retain its unmarked length and non-nasal vowel. No immediate recent donor is established by these sources; no source transcription or identity is altered.

Turner10951 gives Prakrit laṁba long and regional Kumaoni lāmo, Nepali lāmu alongside lambā/lammā. Dhakal p55 explicitly identifies lamʰo as a lexeme with intervocalic breathy nasal; retain that feature rather than treating it as a typo or an independent h segment. This is a family assignment, not a claim that Turner documents the Darai breathiness. No immediate recent donor is established by these sources; no source transcription or identity is altered.

Turner12578 gives Nepali siyāl and Bihari/Bhojpuri/Awadhi siyār. Dhakal pp65–66 explicitly uses /sjar/ jackal to illustrate a consonant-plus-glide onset. The source r-final form follows the eastern siyār comparison, not an assumed correction to Nepali -l. No immediate recent donor is established by these sources; no source transcription or identity is altered.
